description: Parse an iCalendar (.ics) feed from a URL (SSRF-safe; Google / Outlook / Apple calendar exports) or inline text into JSON: calendar name and zone, events with start / end in any IANA zone, all-day flag, location, organizer, attendee count, status and recurrence rule in English. Give a from / to window to expand recurring events (RRULE, EXDATE, RDATE, RECURRENCE-ID overrides) into concrete occurrences. Windows time-zone names are mapped to IANA. Price: $0.003 USDC per successful call (x402, Solana). Same tool over HTTPS: POST https://scorptech.it.com/api/x402/v1/ics-parse

tz.description: Output IANA zone (default the calendar's zone or UTC)

url.description: URL of an .ics feed (or use ics)

name: ics_parse
title: Ics Parse
